title: Bicuspid Aortic Valve Stenosis Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement Registry
brief_summary: The objective of this study is to evaluate the procedural and clinical outcomes of patients with bicuspid aortic valve stenosis undergoing transcatheter aortic valve replacement.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Age≥18 years.
2. Severe aortic stenosis with bicuspid anatomy.
3. NYHA≥2 and/or syncope and/or angina.
4. Patient judged by the Heart Team as indicated for TAVR.

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Age \<18 years
2. Asymptomatic patients
3. Pure aortic regurgitation.
study_population: All consecutive patients presenting with severe and symptomatic bicuspid aortic valve stenosis or mixed disease
